clauses.text:
1.1 'Confidential Information' means all proprietary technical, financial, client, and legal data disclosed by
either Party during the term of this Agreement.
1.2 'Effective Date' means 15th January 2025 unless otherwise extended in writing by the Parties.

2.1 The Second Party shall perform the deliverables and obligations described in Schedule A in strict
compliance with industry standards applicable in Sialkot, Punjab.
2.2 In consideration thereof, the agreed commercial value is PKR 950,000 monthly minimum, payable net 15
days from receipt of an undisputed tax invoice under Pakistan tax regulations.

3.1 Each Party represents that it holds full corporate authority and legal capacity under the laws of Pakistan to
enter into this Agreement.
3.2 Each Party shall indemnify and hold harmless the other against third-party claims arising from gross
negligence, willful misconduct, or breach of statutory obligations.

4.1 Except for breaches of confidentiality or indemnity obligations, neither Party shall be liable for indirect,
incidental, or consequential damages. Aggregate liability shall not exceed total fees paid or payable during the
preceding twelve (12) months.

5.1 This Agreement remains valid for twelve (12) months from the Effective Date and may be terminated for
convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice.
5.2 Either Party may terminate immediately upon material breach not cured within fourteen (14) days of written
notice. Force Majeure events suspend performance for up to forty-five (45) days.

6.1 This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the Carriage of Goods by Sea /
Road Laws and Contract Act, 1872.
6.2 Any dispute not resolved amicably within fifteen (15) days shall be referred to arbitration under the
Arbitration Act, 1940 seated at Sialkot, Punjab, and the courts at Sialkot, Punjab shall have exclusive
jurisdiction.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties sign below at Sialkot, Punjab.
For Sialkot Surgical Instruments Co.: ______________________ For SwiftPort Logistics (Pvt.) Ltd.:
______________________
